title: Electrolyte engineering enables rapid and durable Zn–air self-charging batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05459A, Communication
Jinghua Cai, Tao Li, Shicong Zhang, Xinji Dong, Tao Zhang, Yang Xu, Yi Shen, Chenyu Wei, Hexian Ma, Fuqiang Huang, Tianquan Lin
N,N-Dimethylacetamide (DMAC) based electrolyte drives the formation of a porous, oxygen-permeable interfacial layer that accelerates Zn2+ transport and continuous oxygen reduction.
